description: Create one inventory organization in Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM.
notes: OrganizationId is generated by Oracle when the organization is created, so this runner keeps it out of the request payload.
For POST/create, use ID fields such as ManagementBusinessUnitId and LegalEntityId. Name fields from GET response are treated as read-only and should not be uploaded.
Use Reference Finder to download Business Unit, Legal Entity, Inventory Organization, and Location IDs from the target instance before filling the upload template.

For ItemGroupingCode ORA_RCS_IGB_DFTN, this runner auto-fills ItemDefinitionOrganizationCode from OrganizationCode when blank and will not send ItemDefinitionOrganizationId. For ORA_RCS_IGB_RFRC, fill ItemDefinitionOrganizationId or ItemDefinitionOrganizationCode from an existing definition/reference org.
Advanced inventory parameter fields are optional. Empty Excel cells are skipped from the JSON payload, so only filled optional fields are sent to Oracle.
Use Mock/Dry Run mode first before posting to DEV/TEST/PROD.

Minimal Create IO columns: OrganizationCode, OrganizationName, ManagementBusinessUnitId, LegalEntityId, ProfitCenterBusinessUnitId, Status, LocationId, InventoryFlag, MasterOrganizationId, ItemGroupingCode, ItemDefinitionOrganizationCode, and invOrgParameters.ScheduleId.
